title: Complementing machine output
statement: Given a nondeterministic Turing machine with $k$ work tapes, Boolean output symbols, and state set $Q$, form a machine with the same initial state and transition behavior except that every emitted output symbol is replaced by its Boolean complement. The machine's choice bit, input-head movement, work-tape actions, and successor state remain those specified by the original transition.
